title: Gymmi AI
lines: A workout journal with AI scheduling and coach matching
A public student MVP with a private cloud journal

Matan Roditi
AI Development final project

title: First visit and workout workflow
lines: The animated guide shows how to add a workout, schedule with AI, earn EXP and find a coach.
Add a workout to the weekly plan. Mark it complete to update your progress.
When signed in, reload to confirm the cloud save and find the workout in the monthly calendar.
caption: Public app on first visit. Visitors can reopen the guide from the header.

title: EXP, levels and the weekly leaderboard
lines:
Personal progress
Each completed workout earns 100 EXP. Every 500 lifetime EXP adds one level.

Demo friends
Five fictional profiles show levels and weekly EXP. Anyone can view the demo.

Live standings
Signed-in users can opt in with a nickname. The top 20 are ranked by EXP earned Monday to Sunday, Israel time.
caption: Public app in guest mode. The demo table uses fictional data.

title: The browser, the cloud journal and the AI key
lines:
Browser app
The weekly plan and monthly calendar read the same journal.

Supabase
Auth identifies the user.
Postgres stores the journal.
RLS checks ownership.

OpenAI
One function suggests workout dates. A second ranks eligible coaches from the directory.
Both Supabase Edge Functions call OpenAI. The API key stays in Supabase Secrets.

title: AI scheduling with sample busy times
lines: The demo calendar opens automatically for the demo account.
The AI dialog shows sample busy times before a scheduling request.
In a previous rehearsal, the AI suggested Wednesday 18:30–19:00 and Friday 09:30–10:00. Gymmi saves the proposed times after user approval.
caption: AI dialog before a scheduling request. Sample busy times are Wednesday 18:00–18:30 and Friday 09:00–09:30.

title: Adding and scheduling workouts in the calendar
lines:
Add a workout from a day
The plus button pre-fills the selected date. After saving and reloading, the workout remains on that day.

Review and approve an AI suggestion
Approval saves the time to Supabase. After reload, the workout starts at 18:30, when the sample busy block ends.

title: Verification on the public app
lines: Workout dates and times changed only after approval and survived a reload.
The calendar demo avoided sample busy times and saved the schedule in Gymmi.
Two live questionnaires returned the expected demo coaches and the correct contact links.

title: Git workflow and public deployment
lines: Cursor is the code editor. Git records changes on a feature branch.
A commit records a change. Push uploads it to GitHub for a pull request.
Merge into main publishes docs/ through GitHub Pages. The server function deploys separately.
PR #1 adds the coach directory, rating flow and AI questionnaire.

title: Coach directory and AI matching
lines:
01  Browse
Compare specialties, audiences and member ratings.

02  Match
Choose a goal, audience, format and coaching style. AI ranks eligible coaches and explains each match.

03  Contact
Select a coach and open an email draft.

title: Scope and current limits
lines: Production: public HTTPS app, GitHub source and cloud accounts.
AI proposes workout dates and ranks eligible coaches. Users choose what to save or whom to contact.
Google drafts and ICS export are available. The calendar demo uses sample busy times. A live Google connection requires OAuth setup.
Weekly competition uses self-reported workout completions.
Coaches self-publish their details. The two demo profiles and their ratings are fictional.
MVP limits: unverified emails, no password recovery and capped AI requests.
